name: dataportal
description: Sveriges dataportal (dataportal.se), Sweden's national open-data catalogue. This CLI searches and reads datasets, APIs (data services), organisations, specifications, concepts and terminologies through the public EntryScape/EntryStore backends (admin.dataportal.se and editera.dataportal.se). No login is needed.

commands.name: search-datasets
commands.summary: Full-text search of public datasets (dcat:Dataset) in the national catalogue, with sorting and offset paging

params.name: q
params.description: A single search word, matched against title, description, keywords and all text. Use * for everything. Do not use spaces; see notes.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip, used for paging

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order: relevance, or most recently modified/created first

commands.name: search-data-services
commands.summary: Full-text search of public APIs / data services (dcat:DataService) in the catalogue

params.name: q
params.description: A single search word. Use * for all data services.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order

commands.name: search-organisations
commands.summary: Search publishing organisations (foaf:Agent / foaf:Organization) by name or text

params.name: q
params.description: A single search word, e.g. part of the organisation name. Use * for all organisations.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order

commands.name: search-catalog-solr
commands.summary: Advanced: run a raw Solr query against the admin.dataportal.se catalogue store (filter by theme, access rights, publisher, type, with optional facets)

params.name: query
params.description: Solr query in EntryStore syntax. Escape colons inside unquoted URIs as \: (e.g. rdfType:http\://www.w3.org/ns/dcat#Dataset). Always include public:true.

params.name: api_limit
params.description: Results per page (sent to the site as "limit"; clify's own --limit only shapes the output)

params.name: offset
params.description: Number of results to skip

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort order, e.g. 'score desc' or 'modified desc'

params.name: facetFields
params.description: Comma-separated facet fields, e.g. metadata.predicate.uri.<hash>

commands.name: get-entry
commands.summary: Get full DCAT metadata for a dataset, data service (API) or organisation by catalog and entry id (site URL ids like 389_8203 = catalog 389, entry 8203)

params.name: catalog
params.description: Catalog (context) id: the part before '_' in the site URL, e.g. 389 in /datasets/389_8203

params.name: entry
params.description: Entry id: the part after '_', e.g. 8203

commands.name: get-catalog-quality
commands.summary: Get the metadata-quality score (MQA percentage, score, rating) for a catalog

params.name: catalog
params.description: Catalog (context) id, e.g. 778

commands.name: export-metadata
commands.summary: Export an entry's RDF metadata (dataset/API/organisation) as JSON-LD, Turtle, N-Triples or RDF/XML

params.name: catalog
params.description: Catalog (context) id

params.name: entry
params.description: Entry id

params.name: format
params.description: RDF serialization (MIME type)

commands.name: get-concept
commands.summary: Get a concept, terminology or specification entry from the editera store by catalog and entry id (site ids like /concepts/202_4778 or /terminology/202_1)

params.name: catalog
params.description: Context id, the part before '_' (e.g. 202)

params.name: entry
params.description: Entry id, the part after '_' (e.g. 4778)

commands.name: list-detected-apis
commands.summary: List catalogue entries with an automatically detected OpenAPI definition (definition URL, version, format, CORS)

commands.name: get-theme-stats
commands.summary: Count of datasets per EU data theme (Transport, Economy, ...)

commands.name: get-organisation-stats
commands.summary: Organisations ranked by number of published datasets (labels and counts)

commands.name: get-dataset-history
commands.summary: Monthly history of the total number of datasets in the catalogue

commands.name: get-entity-counts
commands.summary: Total counts of concepts, terminologies and specifications

notes: Site URLs use {catalog}_{entry} ids: /datasets/389_8203, /dataservice/50_6104 and /organisations/827_223 map to get-entry catalog=389 entry=8203 (and so on). Concepts (/concepts/202_4778) and terminologies (/terminology/202_1) map to get-concept.

Search results come from EntryStore. Each child has entryId and info, whose URI contains .../store/{catalog}/entry/{entry}. Its metadata is keyed by resource URI and holds the dcterms:title, dcterms:description and dcat:keyword values.
q in the search commands is put straight into a Solr expression. Use one word or a wildcard (traf*). For multi-word or complex queries, use search-catalog-solr.
Paging uses offset. The response field 'results' is the total hit count. The website's s=8 ('Senast ändrad') corresponds to sort='modified desc'.
The organisation and specification rdfType filters were inferred from the DCAT-AP-SE and dx-prof models, not captured exactly in the recording.
